_about: The words and colours of each ask's share picture, read by tools/og_images.py (drawing) and tools/share_pics.mjs (the versions' words), so the two never differ (R-183). 'short' is one line for small places on a template; 'foot' is the ask said as a request; 'art' names the drawing when there is no issue.
